verdicts.note: Watch-out example did not show a missing hypothesis (2|6, 3|6 tests a different claim). Replaced with 2|4 but 2 does not divide 5, since 4 does not divide 5.
Closing sentence 'fails in both directions' was vague; reworded to say exactly one fails with none or with two or more.
Indexing note was misleading; now says the conventions agree from F_1 on and the other books omit F_0.
Used 'bijection' before it is taught in the functions unit; reworded as labelling each class by one number in [0,1).
